title: validate-json-schema rejects the LinkRef x-substrate-theory annotation
description: Obsolete by operator correction on 2026-07-20: substrate schemas do not use x- extension keywords. The LinkRef theory claims were rehomed into standard JSON Schema $comment annotations, and Vaporize remains strict about unknown keywords.
acceptanceCriteria: LinkRef v0.0.5 contains no x- extension keyword.
Theory claims survive under standard JSON Schema $comment annotations.
Vaporize continues to refuse genuinely unsupported keywords loudly.
The Root/fleet workflow instance validates against role-workflow-schemas v0.0.8 and the current LinkRef v0.0.5 schema.
Schema-theory audit reads the standard $comment markers.

relatedTypedRecords.t: Root and fleet sync-context capture instance
